stories.h: Canada wins a three-day reprieve from threatened 50% US tariffs
stories.w: A last-minute pause protected about $20bn in Canadian exports while Ottawa and Washington finish trade documents. The proposed revival of Keystone XL adds an energy-policy stake to the talks.

stories.h: Ukraine's dismissed defence minister calls for a wartime presidential election
stories.w: Mykhailo Fedorov issued the most direct political challenge to Volodymyr Zelenskyy since Russia's full-scale invasion, arguing that democratic renewal cannot wait for the war to end.

stories.h: Severe storms kill one in Germany as Balkan wildfires keep burning
stories.w: A tornado, widespread structural damage and power outages hit several German states while firefighters in Serbia, Croatia and Bosnia fought heat-fuelled fires.

stories.h: Hakainde Hichilema wins a second term after Zambia's troubled election
stories.w: The president took about 60% of the vote after counting was briefly suspended, soldiers deployed in Lusaka and opposition officials were arrested. EU observers said the wider process limited fundamental freedoms.

stories.h: US and South Korea cut their joint military exercise six days short
stories.w: Seoul said the Ulchi Freedom Shield drill would end early at Washington's request. South Korean officials said they had not been warned before the US decision.

stories.h: A second fatal Philippine school shooting in two months raises pressure for action
stories.w: A ninth-grade student killed a classmate and himself in Zamboanga while livestreaming the attack. Investigators are tracing firearms reportedly owned by the shooter's father, a customs agent.

stories.h: Australia forces Roblox to overhaul child privacy and contact controls
stories.w: The eSafety commissioner found that adults could still view and contact child accounts without parental consent. Roblox has three months to implement changes and submit to an independent audit.

stories.h: Human review raised care funding for one in five older Australians who appealed
stories.w: Government data showed 141 of 757 challenges produced a better result after an algorithm set home-support funding. The system does not let assessors override the algorithm at the initial decision.
